name: Aspect Ratio Cropper
description: Crop any image to a specific aspect ratio with common presets — 1:1, 4:3, 16:9 and stock-platform squares — then download it.
body:
✂️

Drop an image here or click to browse

Drag the crop box to frame your subject

Upload an image to start cropping.

Click and drag to reposition the crop area.
howto: Pick the target aspect ratio (square, 16:9, stock squares and more).
Drag inside the crop area to position the crop frame over the best part of the image.
Choose the output format (JPG, PNG or WebP).
Click Download crop to save the result.
features: Freeform mode for any ratio you type

faq.q: Do stock platforms prefer a specific aspect ratio?
faq.a: Many platforms feature square and 4:3 images prominently, and some categories expect exact ratios. This tool covers the most common presets plus freeform.
Cropping discards pixels outside the frame — that is expected. The remaining pixels are re-encoded at full quality, so there is no additional quality loss beyond the crop itself.

faq.q: Can I set a custom ratio like 5:4?
faq.a: Yes. Choose Freeform and type any ratio such as 5:4 or 21:9 in the width:height format.
No. Everything happens locally on a canvas; nothing is sent to a server.
